name: IEF Elephant Conservation and Research Funding Support
summary: Annual small grants (average award $15,000 per year) from the International Elephant Foundation for field projects on human-elephant conflict, habitat conservation, anti-poaching and related elephant work. Applications for 2027 funding have closed.
